**The problem you're trying to solve**

What are you trying to understand or review, and what makes BitVanes fall
short today? (This matters more than the proposed solution.)

**Proposed solution**

What you'd want to happen instead.

**Language(s) involved**

BitVanes ships tree-sitter grammars for Rust, Go, Solidity, TypeScript/TSX and
Python, and falls back to line heuristics elsewhere. If your request is about
a language, name it — and whether an approximate (line-based) walkthrough of
it would already help.

**Alternatives you considered**

Anything else you tried (another extension, a workflow, a workaround).
